_comment: External benchmarks used to validate the HMDA 2024 figures computed in this
repository. Every value below is taken from a named public source; the
'our_value' entries are filled in from results/*.json by
src/external_validation.py, which also records the comparison.
The point of this file is that every headline number in the report can be
checked against something published by somebody else. Where the two
disagree, the report says so rather than quietly preferring our number.

pmms_2024.series: 30-year fixed-rate mortgage average, annual average of 52 weekly observations
pmms_2024.publisher: Freddie Mac, Primary Mortgage Market Survey (via FRED series MORTGAGE30US)
pmms_2024.caveat: PMMS covers conventional, conforming, fully amortising home-purchase loans for borrowers with excellent credit and 20 % down. HMDA covers every lender and every loan purpose, so the two populations differ and the rates are not expected to be identical.

fhfa_conforming_limit_2024.description: National baseline conforming loan limit for a one-unit property, 2024

hmda_national_2024.publisher: Consumer Financial Protection Bureau, HMDA public LAR, 2024 One Year release
hmda_national_2024.note: Denial rate is denials divided by applications with a decision, i.e. excluding withdrawals and incomplete applications.

hmda_national_2024_by_purpose.publisher: CFPB HMDA public LAR, 2024 One Year release
hmda_national_2024_by_purpose._note: Denial rate per 100 applications with a decision.

hmda_national_2024_by_derived_sex.publisher: CFPB HMDA public LAR, 2024 One Year release
hmda_national_2024_by_derived_sex._note: HMDA's own 'derived sex' field, which classifies a record as Joint when a co-applicant is present.

hmda_national_2024_by_loan_type.publisher: CFPB HMDA public LAR, 2024 One Year release

cnbc_inside_mortgage_finance_purchase_on.publisher: Inside Mortgage Finance, 27 May 2025, analysis of HMDA data
cnbc_inside_mortgage_finance_purchase_on.caveat: Purchase mortgages only. Denominator and year-on-year comparison differ from the CFPB release, so this is reported as a secondary reference, not as the headline.

our_values._comment: Filled in by src/external_validation.py from the results/ artefacts.
